What this run shows about the strategy

Measured on this run's own baskets and fills; the numbers are in diagnostics.json.

1
37.5% of baskets win, and it needs 51.3% to break even
The average winner is $40.38, the average loser -$42.49: one average loss cancels 1 wins. The worst basket (-$1,030.98) cancels 26. The 10 worst baskets gave back 121% of everything the winners made. The margin over break-even is -13.8 points.
2
The ladder's big tiers fire together, at one price
30% of all ladder adds came within 3 seconds of the previous fill. By tier: M15 fired within 10 s of the add before it 65% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.19 per unit away); H1 fired within 10 s of the add before it 92% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.10 per unit away); H4 fired within 10 s of the add before it 100% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.10 per unit away). Those tiers carry most of the basket's size, so the 'averaging' is one large clip, not a ladder.
3
Full ladders: 26% win $178.75, the rest lose -$243.49
19 baskets reached all 6 positions; together they made -$2,515.04 (worst -$1,030.98). Baskets with no add made -$5.64 in total; baskets with at least one add made -$2,003.11.
4
The slope exit closes losers near their worst price
65% of losing baskets were closed within 10% of the largest loss they ever showed. Losers were held a median 37 minutes (one in ten longer than 6.7 h, the longest 58.6 h); 70% of them had been in profit first. Winners were at worst -$595.58 under water before coming back.
5
Spread paid: $195.44
That is 7% of the gross profit of the winning baskets; before spread the run would have netted -$1,813.31 instead of -$2,008.75. Median spread at entry: $0.16 per unit.

Where the money came from, and where it went

While flat the bot polled 1,009,032 times: the open score wanted a trade but the force-close score vetoed it on 28.6% of those polls, the re-entry cooldown blocked a ready signal on 1.4%, and the trading window on 0.4%. A ladder tier hit its RSI level but was held back by the open-score gate on 6,366 polls; 309,906 polls were spent holding a full ladder.
